name: Breakout List

sources.title: Breakout List — 'Great startups to join' curated by @chrisbarber; 15 investors picked 92 startups; filters by headcount band, raised ≤$150M, portfolio vs non-portfolio picks

conditions: Purely curated — inclusion requires an investor in Chris Barber's network to pick the startup as a great place to work; there is no submission form
requirements: No submission — the list is compiled from named investors' picks (Aashay Sanghvi, Elad Gil, Keith Rabois, Sonya Huang, etc.)
Profile: high-growth startups, mostly SF/LA, curated by headcount band — the list exists for job-seekers
The only lever is reaching the curator (@chrisbarber) or the participating investors
preparation: A genuinely breakout trajectory — investor-picked companies are typically funded/high-growth
workflow: No public flow — the route is being nominated by one of the participating investors or persuading the curator
Alternatively build the profile that earns a pick (growth, talent magnetism)
watchFor: Not a launch destination — it's a jobs-discovery list
Inclusion is a network effect, not a form
Solo-maintained — update cadence is the curator's
countsAsLive: The company appears in the Breakout List table with founders/HQ
unknowns: Whether the curator accepts inbound requests
